1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are specifically formatted proofs of claim documents for filing with bankruptcy courts;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and include creditor-specific information identifying the creditor and the debt owed;
and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations via direct electronic submission to each bankruptcy organization's filing system.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step comprises transforming the received data records into court-specific formats compatible with each court's electronic filing requirements.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim and identifying a specific debtor and a specific creditor;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations and are formatted according to each bankruptcy organization's specific filing requirements;
and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations via direct electronic submission to each bankruptcy court's electronic filing system.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the proofs of claims are electronically formatted and transmitted directly to each court's filing system.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages are automatically generated and sent only after proofs of claims have been successfully filed with the bankruptcy organizations and notify the creditors of the filing status of their specific proofs of claims.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol and validating the authenticity of each creditor before accepting the data records.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site, wherein the Web site requires creditor authentication and encryption of transmitted data.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims by bankruptcy organization and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day with each respective bankruptcy organization's electronic filing system.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to each creditor showing the status of proofs of claims filed on behalf of that creditor; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site and providing real-time status information regarding filed proofs of claims.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed, including reasons specific to each bankruptcy organization's filing requirements.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim from the bankruptcy organization and storing the receipt as evidence of filing.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer that maintains separate connections to each bankruptcy organization's filing system.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record to ensure compliance with the specific bankruptcy organization's filing requirements before generating the proof of claim.
